name: healthz-lookalike
description: An attacker who knows the benign pattern imitates it: a request for /healthz with the uptime monitor's user agent, from an address that is not the monitor's. Nothing in the request is prose, so no class fact flags it; both class facts are the ones the real monitor gets. Only the source address, which the attacker cannot choose freely, tells them apart.

web-01.role: public web server, nginx, serves the marketing site; monitored by an external uptime service

benign_patterns.description: Uptime checks from the external monitoring service against /healthz every minute
